description: Handle large datasets with ease and professional-grade performance. The Filtered Table by Elwaha.net is an advanced data grid designed to bridge the gap between simple tables and complex data analysis. Optimized for high-speed performance, it uses virtual scrolling technology to render over 30,000 rows with zero lag. Key Features: High-Speed Virtual Scrolling: Navigate through massive datasets smoothly; the visual only renders what is on screen, ensuring lightning-fast performance. Integrated Search & Filtering: Features a global search toolbar to find any record instantly, plus individual multi-select filters for every column. Live Aggregation Footer: Calculate Sum, Average, Min, Max, Count, or Unique Count on-the-fly directly in the table footer. Progress Bar Visualization: Transform numeric values into interactive horizontal progress bars with threshold-based conditional coloring (Red/Yellow/Green). Status Badges & Dots: Automatically convert text categories into professional "Status Badges" with optional health dots for at-a-glance status tracking. Interactive UX: Supports manual column resizing and drag-and-drop column reordering. Privacy Focused: All data processing, searching, and calculations occur locally within your Power BI environment. No data is ever transmitted externally.
